column1: # Declared mutations: the perturbation each pinning citation must die under.
# Four TAB-separated fields — cited test name, tracked path, `from`, `to`. `\n` and `\t` are unescaped in the
# two substrings, so a perturbation spanning lines is still one record. Blank lines and lines opening with `#`
# `from` must occur EXACTLY once in the file it names. An anchor matching twice names a set rather than a site,
# and `scripts/check_pin_bites.sh` refuses to judge rather than substituting the first occurrence.
# A record is added only after it has been RUN and seen to kill the pin it names. A mutation that fails to
# perturb the pinned point reports a biting pin as a dead one — the safe direction, but it is noise, and the
# gate's own matrix is what proves the refusal rather than a record standing in for it.
